switcher.denied: You do not have permission to list these.
switcher.unavailable: This list could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.

mobileNav.label: Primary
mobileNav.waiting: , {count, plural, one {# approval waiting} other {# approvals waiting}}

account.title: Account
account.emailHint: Your email is how you sign in and cannot be changed here.
account.rolesHint: A role is changed on the Organization page by someone who holds set_member_role, never here. This is where you see what you hold.
account.invalid: That display name was refused. A name is 1 to 120 characters.
account.denied: You do not have permission to change this profile.
account.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.

preferences.denied: You do not have permission to read or change these preferences.
preferences.failed: That could not be done. Try again.
preferences.localeHint: Dates, numbers, and currencies format to this. Machine-readable fields in records, receipts, and exports are never translated.
preferences.invalid: One of those values was refused. A locale is a BCP 47 tag and a time zone is an IANA name.

security.authenticatorOn: TOTP. Recovery codes let you in when the app is not to hand.
security.authenticatorOff: Not set up. A code from an authenticator app is asked for at every sign-in once it is.
security.codesRefused: That password was not accepted. Try again.
security.codesIssued: New recovery codes. The old set is void. Keep these somewhere only you can reach; they are not shown again.
security.sessionsFailed: Your sessions could not be read. Try again.
security.revoked: Session revoked. It ends at its next request.
security.sessionsHint: Revoking a session ends it at the next request. It does not touch an agent credential or a run token. Those are revoked on the Agents page, and that is what makes a halt stick.

privacy.exportHint: A machine-readable bundle of your data, or of the whole organization for an owner or admin. Runs as export_data, a governed action. It queues at once; fetch the bundle from the API by its id when it is ready.
privacy.denied: You do not have permission to export this data.
privacy.deniedOrg: An organization export needs an owner or admin.
privacy.failed: That export could not be queued. Try again.
privacy.erasureHint: Erasure of your data runs as erase_data on the API, with explicit confirmation. It revokes every session at once and schedules the hard delete. It is not a button here.

assistant.label: Assistant
assistant.parked: {count, plural, one {# write is waiting on a person} other {# writes are waiting on a person}}. Approve or deny them on Fleet.
assistant.needsWorkspace: The assistant answers over one workspace. Open a workspace to ask it something.

intro.title: Ask about this workspace
intro.body: The assistant reads this workspace’s runs, agents, spend and knowledge graph. Every turn is recorded as a run of its own.

composer.label: Ask the assistant
composer.placeholder: Ask about a run, an agent, or what this is costing…

refused.denied: You do not have permission to ask the assistant in this workspace.
refused.invalid: That question was refused. A question is 1 to 32,000 characters.
refused.exhausted: This organization has no budget left for the assistant.
refused.parked: That turn is waiting on an approval before it can answer.
refused.unavailable: The assistant could not be reached. Try again.

avatar.title: Your avatar
avatar.iconHint: Lucide glyphs, the set the product ships. One line weight, drawn in the tone's ink.
avatar.photoHint: An https link to a hosted image: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG.
avatar.toneHint: Solid, soft, or line. Three tones from the house scale, each fixing its own glyph colour, so there is no combination that fails.
avatar.note: Saved with update_profile, like any change to your account.
avatar.noPhoto: Paste an https link to a photo first, or switch to an icon or initials.
avatar.invalid: That avatar was refused. Set a display name on the Profile tab, then try again.
avatar.denied: You do not have permission to change this profile.
avatar.failed: That could not be saved. Try again.
